newsitem.title: TURKEY: French opens 87 mln franc soft loan to Turkey.
newsitem.headline: French opens 87 mln franc soft loan to Turkey.

text.p: France opened a soft loan of 87 million francs to Turkey for use in two infrastructure projects, the French embassy in Turkey said on Tuesday.
It said in a statement two countries signed an agreement for the loan on December 20 in Paris.
The loan, to be used for a waste water project in Izmir and a study centre for a university in Istanbul, has a 30-year maturity with a 10-year grace period and an annual interest rate of 0.6 percent.
The embassy said France had opened credit lines to Turkey worth about $1 billion in the past 10 years.
